name: Lost Island Level Pack
author: Addicting Games
description: Lost Level Island Pack is a bubble shooter game with a jungle theme. Dare to walk into this lost island through the mysterious forest to find a snake made of bubbles. No matter what you cannot let this bubble snake escape into the ancient architecture. The objective of this game is to get rid of all the bubbles by matching them in groups of 3 or more. There are 20 levels to this online game. With each level, you get a different set of bubbles that you must destroy. There are obstacles in the way that will cause your bubbles to bounce off and miss their shot. Wait patiently for the bubble snake to slither by until you have a clear shot. Once the moment is right, do not hesitate to take your shot before the bubble snake reaches its goal. Submit your score at the end of the game to see how well you did compare to other players!
